page_title: See your photos in realistic colors

sources.entry: Palette FM - AI for color management on images.

summary.name: Palette FM
summary.one_liner: Palette FM is a web tool that applies one of 21+ color filters to photos to give them vibrant, realistic-looking colors.
use_cases: Making faded or dull photos look more vivid
Applying lifelike color filters to personal snapshots
Previewing color looks on sample before and after images
Quick color touch-ups for social media photos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a photo tool where you upload a picture, choose one of 21+ color filters, and get a transformed version with vibrant, lifelike colors in seconds. It shows before-and-after samples that can be clicked to try the effect. The page lists 6.6M+ users and a 4.9-star rating. It is listed in an awesome-ai-tools collection under AI-related tools and described there as AI for color management on images. The page text does not give technical details about how the filters work.
notable: Click-to-try before and after sample photos
caveats: Pricing and plans are not stated on the page text
Page text gives no details on image privacy or file limits
